methodologyNotes: Published self-serve pricing was confirmed against each provider's own live page on the accessed date; per-seat/per-user tiers record the per-user monthly price (monthly-billing rate) with a note, while flat per-account tiers are marked billingModel flat. Providers whose prices could not be confirmed on a live provider-owned page were dropped during the 2026-06-13 adversarial verification pass: Acuity Scheduling (every official acuityscheduling.com pricing URL returned HTTP 404), YouCanBook.me (live pricing page is JS-rendered and exposed plan structure/limits but no dollar figures), and Square Appointments (official squareup.com appointments pricing page is JS-rendered and exposed no figures). Doodle pricing was corrected from the official Doodle help center, which now lists Pro as a single-user plan at $15/mo ($132/yr) and Team at $19.95/mo monthly (min 2 users) / $8.95/mo annual. Quote-only Enterprise/custom tiers are recorded with monthlyUsd null, and minutesIncluded/callsIncluded/overage fields are null for every plan since they do not apply to scheduling software.
